entries.subject: The colour of the photosphere
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at the published 3,600 K (Xuan et al. 2024), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer into sRGB with the D65 white. Gaia DR3 has no BP/RP spectrum that describes this star alone, and no limb-darkening measurement or model grid in the repository reaches it, so the disc is uniform.
entries.revisitWhen: Gaia publishes a spectrum of this star alone, or a limb-darkening law is measured for it.
